data.name: Saeed
data.gender_notes: Saeed is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root س-ع-د (s-ʿ-d); Saʿīd means 'happy, fortunate'. Its root is س-ع-د (s-ʿ-d). A common Arabic given name. Saeed is a Arabic name meaning “Happy; fortunate; blessed”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Saeed expresses “Happy; fortunate; blessed”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root س-ع-د (s-ʿ-d); Saʿīd means 'happy, fortunate'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Saeed total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
